en: Color-tinted image showing a person walking along a curving path beside a long, ivy‑covered stone ruin with two levels of arched openings. The structure looks partly collapsed, with exposed brickwork and vegetation growing over the walls and on the roof. In the background, a high arched gate or portal stands across the path. The trees are bare, suggesting late autumn or winter. No visible printed caption or text appears on the image side.
